THE WORLD OF DO & CO

DO & CO is one of the world¿s leading premium hospitality and catering companies, employing more than 17,000 people across over 20 countries. Our group includes the renowned brands k. & k. Hofzuckerbäckerei Demel, HENRY and HEDIARD.

DO & CO operates in Austria, Türkiye, Germany, England, Spain, Italy, Poland, South Korea and the United States.

We are searching for a 1 Group Accountant - Consolidation & IFRS Specialist (m/w/x) Location: Wien ,AT

Department: Finance

Contract Type: Full-time

Job Description

YOUR ROLE IN THE WORLD OF DO & CO

As a Group Accountant (m/f/d) with a focus on Consolidation and IFRS, you will be part of our international Group Accounting Team in the heart of Vienna, contributing significantly to accurate and timely group reporting.

Your responsibilities:

 * Contributing to the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS for 93 group entities across 15 countries

 * Acting as the first point of contact for auditors and tax advisors on all group accounting matters

 * Advising group entities on IFRS accounting matters

 * Supporting year-end audits and the overall group consolidation process

 * Actively participating in national and international projects

 * Optimizing and further developing group-wide reporting processes, including automation and digitalization

Qualifications

WHAT SETS YOU APART

 * 4+ years of relevant professional experience in a comparable role within an international environment

 * Excellent knowledge of IFRS; VAT knowledge is an advantage

 * Strong MS Office skills and ERP experience

 * Hands-on mentality, structured working style, and strong communication skills

 * Flexibility and performance-oriented mindset

 * Excellent written and spoken English; German or Turkish are an advantage

Additional Information

YOUR WORK ENVIRONMENT

 * Experience a motivated and dynamic working environment at our international HQ in Vienna's 1st district

 * Be part of a leading ATX-listed company with a global presence

 * Close collaboration with external partners such as auditors and tax advisors

 * Occasional international travel to major events and sporting occasions such as Formula 1, UEFA and FIFA championships, as well as tennis and golf tournaments

 * Individual career opportunities at national and international level

 * Daily complimentary freshly prepared lunch and fruit

OUR ATTRACTIVE OFFER

Starting salary of € 5,500 gross/month on a full-time basis (all-in contract), with willingness to overpay depending on qualifications and individual agreement.

Your place of work is in Vienna's inner city, right next to the Vienna State Opera. A valid work permit for Austria is required.

Does this position appeal to you? Are you motivated and ready for the challenge? We look forward to receiving your application!

Join a company that pioneered cross-border express delivery in ... 1 Ground Safety Expert (m/f/d) Your Responsibility:

 * Prepare, coordinate and facilitate the Ground Safety Action Group and contribute to the Safety Review Board.
 * Maintain and develop the Ground Operations hazard register in close partnership with Ground Operations.
 * Support risk assessments of occurrence reports and contribute to Safety Risk Evaluations on ground safety topics.
 * Own the administration and control of ground safety related reports, SPIs and statistics - spotting trends and following them up with the right people.
 * Represent DHA on ground safety matters with external stakeholders such as Austro Control and DHL group airlines.
 * Be accountable for the quality, integrity and regulatory compliance of the risk data and recommendations you produce, in line with IOSA ISARPs and DHA standards.

Your Qualifications:
 * An undergraduate degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 * 5 years of relevant work experience, including at least 2 years in the aeronautical industry.
 * A dangerous goods training certificate - CAT 10 or similar competency-based DG training preferred.
 * Solid experience with risk management and assurance processes in aviation and familiarity with management systems.
 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.
 * Fluent in English, strong MS Office skills and the interpersonal skills to build effective relationships across the business.
 * The ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and stay composed under pressure.
